page.overview:
Who is Kasha Jinjo?

Reverend Mother Kasha Jinjo was the Truthsayer and confidant of Emperor Javicco Corrino who occupied a position of great influence in the Imperium. A challenge led her to question the intentions of the Bene Gesserit, which left her finding her role increasingly difficult to navigate.

As the Emperor’s own Truthsayer and confidant, Reverend Mother Kasha occupies a position of great influence in the Imperium. When she begins to question the Sisterhood’s intentions, she finds her role increasingly difficult to navigate.

Kasha trained as an acolyte alongside Valya Harkonnen and Francesca. When Dorotea singled Valya out as being uncommitted, Francesca and Kasha told her that wasn't fair. Then the time came for them to take their vows. They had to stand out in the rain until they were ready to put Sisterhood Above All. Kasha was one of the last to make this vow. When Dorotea and Valya's rivalry caused a division in the sisterhood, with everyone choosing a side, Valya told Francesca and Kasha that Raquella was going to name her the next Mother Superior. However, before she did that, she wanted them both to undergo the Agony test. Dorotea was ready for that, while Valya chose to run away.

Kasha was training on Wallach IX when Raquella died. Valya immediately stepped in and seized control of the Sisterhood, influencing Dorotea to kill herself so she could.
